med-bc-01-c1.text: Museum of the History of Science, University of Oxford. Marconi exhibition: Atlantic crossing. Museum of the History of Science, Oxford.
med-bc-01-c1.quote: On 12 December they heard the three dots – the letter ‘S’ in Morse
med-bc-01-c1.claim: In 1901, Guglielmo Marconi sent a transatlantic transmission from Poldhu, Cornwall to Signal Hill, Newfoundland. It carried Morse code dots, not voice or music.

med-bc-01-c3.text: Jefferson Pooley and Michael J. Socolow (2013). The Myth of the War of the Worlds Panic. Slate.
med-bc-01-c3.quote: The supposed panic was so tiny as to be practically immeasurable on the night of the broadcast.
med-bc-01-c3.claim: Later research has substantially deflated claims of mass panic.
